cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(sugarchain_fresh_index_export LANGUAGES CXX)
set(SUGARCHAIN_SOURCE "" CACHE PATH "Pinned Sugarchain source with unchanged vendored LevelDB")
if(NOT EXISTS "${SUGARCHAIN_SOURCE}/cmake/leveldb.cmake")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Set SUGARCHAIN_SOURCE to the audited checkout")
endif()

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${SUGARCHAIN_SOURCE}/cmake/module")
include(TryAppendCXXFlags)
include(CheckCXXSymbolExists)
check_cxx_symbol_exists(fdatasync "unistd.h" HAVE_FDATASYNC)
check_cxx_symbol_exists(O_CLOEXEC "fcntl.h" HAVE_O_CLOEXEC)
add_library(core_interface INTERFACE)
set(diagnostic_source "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}")
set(PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR "${SUGARCHAIN_SOURCE}")
include("${SUGARCHAIN_SOURCE}/cmake/crc32c.cmake")
include("${SUGARCHAIN_SOURCE}/cmake/leveldb.cmake")
set(PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR "${diagnostic_source}")
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
target_link_libraries(core_interface INTERFACE Threads::Threads)
add_executable(export-fresh-index export-fresh-index.cpp)
target_link_libraries(export-fresh-index PRIVATE leveldb)
if(WIN32)
  target_compile_definitions(export-fresh-index PRIVATE NOMINMAX WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN)
endif()
